cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I found our wedding video. You can finally practise watching faces, like I taught you, instead of just listening to speeches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather discuss why we're living separately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Watch your father's face when he says 'good luck'. Now tell me what he meant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Exactly this. Pause it. I don't want another speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good observation, wrong conclusion. We'll skip to the dancing. You used to miss all the background action; see if your uncle actually falls into the cake.
